key_points: Q1 FY2027 results: $8.22B revenue, $2.75B net income; Dec quarter guidance ~$8.6B revenue, $2.33 EPS — in line but cautious
Stock down ~34% in past month on AI spending fears and sector weakness
Bernstein sees 53% upside from current levels, highlighting oversold condition
Annual meeting: routine approvals (directors, pay, auditor) — no governance surprises
Component shortages cited as near-term headwind; longer-term AI demand intact
